title: vicia sativa subsp. obovata
intro: Vicia sativa subsp. obovata, commonly known as Garden Hare's Ear or Hare's Ear, is a subspecies of the common vetch plant, characterized by its hairy, obovate leaves and purple flowers. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to treat digestive issues, respiratory problems, and skin conditions, due to its anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of Vicia sativa subsp. obovata include its analgesic, antispasmodic, and expectorant effects, which can help relieve pain, reduce muscle spasms, and ease respiratory congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
